THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
AFTERLIGHT
017
18 / Cemetery Gothic
A tall figure in a black Victorian-style jacket with a ruffled
collar and a long dark lace-trimmed skirt, her braided hair pulled
back, standing with folded arms between weathered stone grave
markers in an autumn cemetery.
19 / Snowlight
A close portrait of tousled golden curls blowing in the
wind, a blue-gray knit scarf and a dark navy puffer jacket under a
pale winter sky. Intense blue-gray eyes and flushed cheeks
suggest cold air.
